issues.reason: 'were up' is a copula plus a predicative particle — the copular routing ('X is ADJ' -> a categorical atom wrapped in the tense) — and no word 'rise' occurs, so (Member sk_rise_1 rise) is the single-word-synonym substitution the surface-faithfulness rules forbid and fails the point-at-the-words test.
The oblique head must be the preposition actually used — 'in stays In; During renders only the word during' — so (During … sk_trade_1) for 'in … trade' is a near-fit synonym head.
No word in the text types GE; a proper noun takes its Name fact and a kind atom only when the text states the kind ('the Kestrel River'), so (Member ge company) is world knowledge added as content.

A proper-noun nominal modifier is gap territory (the compound rules exclude proper nouns), and Possession is explicitly opaque — it 'covers ownership, kinship, and looser association alike without having to mean ownership' — so (Possession sk_stock_1 ge) for 'GE stock' is true, well-typed improvisation the calibration line licenses.

Same gap; 'New York Stock Exchange trade' answers where the trading happened, and (Location sk_trade_1 new_york_stock_exchange) is true and well-typed — unlike (Member ge company) it is traceable to the modifier that is actually in the text.

(Measure sk_rise_1 price 37 cent) says the change event's price is 37 cents; a delta is not a price value and Measure's scale slot is a dimension of the entity it attaches to, so the atom is false and ill-typed.

'The surface tense decides, mechanically' — a past clause wraps even a fact that still reads as holding ('Alice was 6 feet tall' -> (Past (Measure …))) — and the missing delta-to-level link is the reviewer's own registered gap, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: 'be up/down N <unit> to <value>' — a delta plus a resulting level; Measure, MeasureAtLeast/AtMost, MoreBy and TimesAs all relate entities on a scale and none encodes one entity's value moving by an amount to a new value
a proper-noun nominal modifier on a common noun ('GE stock', 'New York Stock Exchange trade') — proper nouns are excluded from compounding and no alternative attachment is supplied
'in morning <X> trade' as a market/session frame — Time, Location, In and During each mis-describe it; the repair uses In on the state witness as the least-wrong licensed form
new_gaps: a predicative particle ('be up', 'be down') becomes a bare property with no link to the scale it moves on, so (Member sk_stock_1 up) and the price Measure sit in the KB unrelated — nothing says 'up' is movement on `price`
repair_summary: Replaced the invented `rise` event with the surface-faithful copular state for 'were up' — (Member sk_up_1 up), (Experiencer sk_up_1 sk_stock_1), (Past sk_up_1) plus the mandatory flat dual-emit (Past (Member sk_stock_1 up)) — the frame PP being the reification trigger. Dropped (Measure sk_rise_1 price 37 cent): a 37-cent delta is not a price value and no licensed head carries a change-by-amount, so the figure is left out and recorded as a gap. Dropped (Member ge company) as unstated. Re-headed the frame PP to the preposition actually used and anchored it on the state witness: (In sk_up_1 sk_trade_1) replaces (During sk_rise_1 sk_trade_1). The stock/Possession, trade and NYSE atoms and the $28.56 price Measure are unchanged.
